entities.summary: Daniel Ray Robertson is an American former professional baseball infielder. He was drafted by the Oakland Athletics in the first round of the 2012 Major League Baseball draft. He made his Major League Baseball (MLB) debut with the Tampa Bay Rays in 2017 and has also played for the San Francisco Giants and Milwaukee Brewers.
